claim_being_audited: Whether certifying the current model release is compliant under the model-card certification policy based on aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and documentation/monitoring of the current fraud dispute review subgroup regression.
decision_criteria: If current release documentation explicitly reflects the current evaluation results and discloses the material subgroup weakness, the action could move toward compliant_with_caveats.
If an approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance exists for the subgroup regression, the policy predicate could be satisfied.
If neither disclosure nor approved mitigation/risk acceptance exists for the current release, certification remains noncompliant with policy.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but not sufficient by themselves under the stated policy.
evidence_requests: Current release model-card or certification packet showing the current evaluation results are reflected.
Approved disclosure text or released documentation explicitly describing the fraud dispute review subgroup weakness.
Approved mitigation for the material subgroup regression, or reviewed and owner-approved risk acceptance tied to this release.
Evidence identifying the approval owner and confirming review of the current-release limitation.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses or cover them by approved mitigation.
The available summary indicates a material subgroup regression in the fraud dispute review slice.
The available summary also indicates there is no attached approved mitigation, no owner-approved risk acceptance, and no attached disclosure language for the subgroup weakness.
Prior approval and informal monitoring are explicitly contextual only under the policy and cannot substitute for current-release support.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record.
That documentation and monitoring alone satisfy the policy without evidence that the current release documentation actually includes the subgroup weakness disclosure.
That prior approval of the model family materially supports current-release certification beyond context.
